panels.title: Input — flat call table

panels.description: SQL Expression B renames `caller` and `callee` to `source` and `target`. It also creates `id` and converts `count` to numeric `mainstat`.

targets.csvContent:
caller,callee,calls
gateway,api,1200
gateway,web,800
api,auth,650
api,db,900
auth,db,300
db,api,120
web,api,450

targets.expression:
SELECT CONCAT(caller, '->', callee) AS id,
       caller AS source,
       callee AS target,
       CAST(calls AS DECIMAL(20, 4)) AS mainstat
FROM A

panels.title: Reshaped — edges frame

panels.description: SQL Expression C combines both endpoint columns into one list of unique nodes. This frame is optional, but it can provide node titles, subtitles, and values.

targets.csvContent:
caller,callee,calls
gateway,api,1200
gateway,web,800
api,auth,650
api,db,900
auth,db,300
db,api,120
web,api,450

targets.expression:
SELECT DISTINCT n.id AS id, n.id AS title
FROM (SELECT caller AS id FROM A
      UNION
      SELECT callee AS id FROM A) AS n
